questions.question: Rank the following events on a scale from 0 (Impossible) to 1 (Certain). Label each event: Impossible, less likely, equally likely (even chance), more likely, certain. Give reasons why you gave each event its ranking. **(i)** The next Monday will come after Sunday. **(ii)** It will snow in Mumbai in July. **(iii)** An elephant will walk through your classroom today. **(iv)** You will greet at least one friend at school tomorrow.

solution.content: **(i) The next Monday will come after Sunday — Certain (Probability = 1).** Days of the week always follow a fixed order; Sunday is always followed by Monday. This will definitely happen.
**(ii) It will snow in Mumbai in July — Impossible (Probability = 0).** Mumbai has a tropical climate and experiences the monsoon in July with hot, humid weather. Snowfall is not possible there.

**(iii) An elephant will walk through your classroom today — Impossible (Probability = 0).** Under normal circumstances this practically cannot happen, so its probability is 0 (or extremely close to 0).

**(iv) You will greet at least one friend at school tomorrow — More likely (Probability close to 1, but not exactly 1).** There are many friends around you at school, so it is very likely. It is not certain because rare situations (like being absent or school being closed) could prevent it.

questions.answer: (i) Certain (1)  (ii) Impossible (0)  (iii) Impossible (0)  (iv) More likely (close to 1)
questions.notes: **Exam Tip:** Probability 0 means impossible, 1 means certain, and most real events lie strictly between 0 and 1.
